core_promise: Build practical spoken English for everyday life through progressive speaking outcomes.
weekly_structure: 1 weekly speaking outcome → 7 daily mini-outcomes → 1–4 quests/day
repeat_track: Missed skills generate parallel retry items; the learner repeats the skill, not necessarily the exact question.
speaking_priority: Speak + Converse are the primary output modes. Learn, Translate, Listen, Read and Write support spoken performance.
grammar_philosophy: Teach grammar just-in-time when it unlocks a speaking outcome; avoid a grammar-first syllabus.
spaced_repetition: Review older skills at adaptive intervals; suggested checkpoints include 1, 2, 4, 7, 14 and 30 days.
